situation.goal: materialize the first real governed public corpus without wasting scarce GPU compute

failure_1.symptom: httpx.ConnectError: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution
failure_1.failure_point: HfApi.dataset_info before any source rows were accepted

decision.stop_condition: same external network failure reproduced on a second independent CPU compute node
decision.interpretation: network-egress/runtime-boundary failure, not corpus semantics or provenance failure

route_split.reason: keep Kaggle GPU quota unused while moving only the stage that requires external network access

implementation.integrity: SHA-256-bound archive, transfer manifest, per-file hashes, corpus/tokenizer receipt preservation
implementation.privacy: public corpus/tokenizer only; no private identity data; no private gradient; no model weights

lesson: Compute capability and network capability are separate route dimensions. After the same environmental failure reproduces on multiple nodes, stop node roulette. Split the pipeline at the smallest stable artifact boundary, run the network-dependent stage where egress is available, preserve cryptographic/provenance lineage across transfer, and return training to the strongest validated accelerator route.
future_builder_policy: treat network egress as a first-class runtime capability
differentiate semantic/data failures from infrastructure failures
after replicated infrastructure failure, change route rather than add retries
prefer CPU-only external preprocessing when GPU quota is scarce
bind cross-environment transfers with receipts and per-file hashes
